steps.question: Who is the speaker in the poem?

questionMeaning.hi: कविता में बोलने वाला कौन है?
questionMeaning.hinglish: Kavita mein bolne waala kaun hai?

steps.modelAnswer: The speaker in the poem is a child.

modelMeaning.hi: कविता में बोलने वाला एक बच्चा है।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Kavita mein bolne waala ek bachcha hai.

steps.question: Who told the secret to the boy?
steps.modelAnswer: The cherry tree told the secret to the boy.

modelMeaning.hi: चेरी के पेड़ ने बच्चे को राज़ बताया।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Cherry ke ped ne bachche ko raaz bataaya.

steps.question: What does the poet mean by ‘four little ...’?
steps.modelAnswer: By ‘four little’ the poet means four little eggs laid by the robin in her nest.

modelMeaning.hi: ‘four little’ का मतलब है रॉबिन के घोंसले में रखे चार छोटे अंडे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: ‘four little’ ka matlab hai robin ke ghonsle mein rakhe chaar chhote ande.

steps.question: Who told the secret to the tree?
When will the secret be out?
options: when the little birds fly out
steps.answer: when the little birds fly out
steps.modelAnswer: The secret will be out when the little birds hatch and fly out of the nest.

modelMeaning.hi: राज़ तब खुलेगा जब छोटे बच्चे अंडों से निकलकर घोंसले से उड़ जाएँगे।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Raaz tab khulega jab chhote bachche andon se nikalkar ghonsle se ud jaayenge.

steps.question: What is the secret?
options: The robin has built a nest in the cherry tree and laid four eggs.
The tree is going to fall.
steps.answer: The robin has built a nest in the cherry tree and laid four eggs.
steps.modelAnswer: The secret is that the robin has built a nest in the cherry tree and laid four little eggs in it.

modelMeaning.hi: राज़ यह है कि रॉबिन ने चेरी के पेड़ पर घोंसला बनाया है और उसमें चार छोटे अंडे दिए हैं।
modelMeaning.hinglish: Raaz yeh hai ki robin ne cherry ke ped par ghonsla banaaya hai aur usmein chaar chhote ande diye hain.
